instrument: Operator statements at a public open house
summary: The operator states the facility would use water for cooling only about 7 percent of the time and consume approximately 14 million gallons annually, which it compares to less than a comparably sized irrigated farm circle. The Port provides water and process water treatment but not electricity.

source.citation: Tri-Cities Area Journal of Business and regional reporting of the Burbank open house, September 2026

notes: A comparison-based water claim of the same structure as the Hillsboro solar-plant comparison already graded in this corpus: the assertion is not a volume but a ratio against a chosen denominator, and the denominator is the contestable part. The operator also states it would pay 100 percent of property taxes, consistent with Washington's incentive structure, which operates through a sales and use tax exemption on equipment rather than property-roll relief.
confidence_note: No engineering document, water right or utility record has been read. The 7 percent figure, the 14 million gallon figure and the farm circle comparison are all operator statements at a public meeting and none has been checked. This entry records that the claim was made, not that it is accurate.
